title: Assessing Data Readiness: A Review of SEAWA's Resources for the State of the Watershed Report
description: A systematic review of available internal and external data sources, coded against the Freshwater Health Index to assess SEAWA's readiness for an updated State of the Watershed report.

title: A Literature Review of Chloride in the South Saskatchewan River Sub Basin
description: A literature review on chloride in the freshwater systems of southeast Alberta, covering sources, impacts, monitoring, management, water literacy, and climate.
